title: Second Normal Form (2NF) and Composite Keys
realWorldScenario: An order items table has a composite primary key (order_id, product_id). It also stores product_name and product_category in the same row.
questionStatement: Why does storing product_name in this composite-key table violate Second Normal Form (2NF)? Explain 2NF and partial dependencies.
expectedConcepts: Non-key attributes must depend on the whole composite primary key
hints: Ask yourself: Does product_name change when order_id changes?
